properties.displayName: UAV S80 - Cross-segment ISR Handoff Target Data Tampering
properties.description: Cross-segment(예: AF-to-Army) ISR 핸드오프 시 표적좌표(TargetCoordBefore/After)가 변경되고 변경자(HandoffOperator)가 Approved_Operators_List에 없는 비인가자인 경우를 탐지. 핸드오프 구간 표적정보 조작 위험. MITRE: T1565, T0832
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let ApprovedOps = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Operators_List') | project OperatorId;
UAVIsrHandoff_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType == 'TargetHandoff'
| extend isCoordChanged = (TargetCoordBefore != TargetCoordAfter)
| extend isUnapprovedOperator = HandoffOperator !in (ApprovedOps)
| where isCoordChanged and isUnapprovedOperator
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("ISR핸드오프_표적좌표변조_", Boundary, "_변경자:", HandoffOperator)
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, Boundary, TargetCoordBefore, TargetCoordAfter, HandoffOperator, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S80 - ISR Handoff Target Data Tampering - {{Boundary}}
